title: controller_timer_helpers typo-RAM gates and remaining mutants (already installed)

prove.spec_note: Private copy only; shared lowers/chunks/spec.json was not written.
prove.result: all 13 symbols EQUIVALENT 100 vs HEAD literals, with the gate-opening PRE_H

gates.controller_timer_word: Previously classes=1 (always update). PRE_H sets 0xf00414 to packed on even t and ~packed on odd t. Now rets 0 and 1 are 50/50; both the no-update and update gates run. No typo-RAM site.
gates.timer_threshold_flags: PRE_H plants timer_context at RB+0x2000 with count=6 and mask=0x3f. ret is always the planted pointer (classes=1) but memhash is unique on all 100 cases, so the threshold loop ran. Mutant of u32_80fde0->u32_80fde8 KILLED memhash:100 ret:100.
gates.timer_initialize: Mode cycles 0..4. Banks 0/1 and 2/3 return context (80 cases); the other-mode gate returns last (20 cases ret=4). 100 unique memhashes. Mode mutant u32_80199c->u32_8019b0 KILLED ret:89 memhash:77.
gates.timer_irq_enable: No typo-RAM. Already classes=2; with MMIO fill, previous enable bit returns 0 on 85 cases and 1 on 15. Both enable and previous-bit gates run. No typo-RAM mutant.
gates.timer_config_pair: Already 76-83 classes from typo-RAM stores. Mutant u32_8019b0->u32_8019b8 KILLED memhash:100.
gates.timer_changed: Mode 0 or 2 is now 40/100 cases (was 7 timer_word calls). Product tables planted at RB+0x2200/0x2300. Mutant u32_8012c4->u32_8012c0 KILLED callhash:40.

mutants.survived_then_retried: timer_enable interval u32_80fde8->u32_80fdf4 SURVIVED (update=0 path is rare when enable!=0). Retried on the observed u8_8019a0 selected field and KILLED.
